title: Geralyn AS NDE 4053
content: It was three months into being diagnosed with Burkitt's Lymphoma. At the time, due to my age (thirteen), I was not told of the severity of the illness. Only my parents and elders in my family knew that I was given a one percent chance of survival. In fact, the doctors told them that they should prepare for my 'arrangements' as they believed I was not going to survive this illness. The disease had ravished my body and the spleen, liver and intestines where filled with tumors. One evening, while hospitalized, I was eating some popcorn when suddenly I began to feel this immense pain in my stomach. I felt the need to pass my bowels, but could not; two days later, I still could not and began regurgitating my food. It was discovered that a large tumor was blocking my bowels. I was immediately sent to surgery. During the surgery I died. For how long I cannot say, but, I had no sensation of passing, I went from laying on the gurney, to floating in the air above the doctors. I watched as they pulled out my intestines, carefully laying them to the side of my body, and then they began racing around (I presume in an attempt to revive me). During this, I began rising, and all at once it seemed as though I knew everything there was to know. It seemed as if all the mysteries of the world were being revealed. I understood science, math, and life! Simultaneously, I could see people below me in other rooms, I saw my grandmother and great-aunt crying outside the operating area, I saw other patients being treated in other surgery rooms, and I saw people outside the hospital. I saw so much and I continued to rise. Then as instantly as I rose, I was instantly present within something that resembled a cloud. I don't say it was a cloud but it was bright, white and soft. I felt the total embrace of LOVE. I knew I was in a place of great safety and warmth. I saw what could have been angels, three. They had great peace about them and they were part of this 'cloud' as if attached directly to it. They didn't say anything to me, yet, I felt the grandness of them and their joy. I was happy, peaceful and desired to stay amongst them. Suddenly, a large hand came towards me. I can't even express its size as everything there was more than words could express. All I know is that it was a non-threatening hand, and it glowed with a over powering light. Then I heard a voice that seemed soft, yet authoritative, tell me, 'My child, go back, for you have much work left to do!' I was instantly back in my body. INSTANTLY! When I awoke, I told the doctors what I saw them doing to me during the operation, they were amazed at my preciseness of their work. Actually, they had removed two and half feet of my intestines. Still, they didn't believe the story. I also remember feeling angry that I had to return. I knew that I was healed. The doctors were awe struck to find that after only one chemo treatment the tumors were gone. And that treatment was given against my will as I was too young for them to hear my protest. Thirty-seven years later, I am still here. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Experience 2: My second experience was due to an overdose of sleep medication. That experience took place seven years ago when I was forty-three. I was suffering severe depression and foolishly, in an attempt to sleep, or possibly commit suicide (either way was fine with me at the time) I took more than thirty potent sleeping pills. This was a slower experience than the first. Everything that happened seemed to happen in slow motion. All I know is that I slowly fell into 'sleep'. When I awoke, I was in a dark, dark place. Totally void of light. I lifted up my hand and couldn't see it. There was nothingness all around me. Slowly I began to hear noises, ever so slowly they became louder until I realized that I was hearing the moaning and groaning of what sounded like hundreds (maybe thousands) of people. They were shouting, screaming, yelling in pain and sorrow. I couldn't see any of them; all I could do was hear their cries. Fear began to overtake my heart, panic was setting in and then I felt this sensation crawling up my legs, the left first, then the right. Instinctually I knew that if it engulfed me I would forever be in this place and I would be among those who were left in their misery. As the sensation came close to touching my belly, again, I saw this large, bright hand reach in, ALL that I could see was the light of this hand. Again, I heard that soft and authoritative voice say to me, 'My child, this is not what I want for you!' I felt as if someone was blowing air into my lungs and I rose taking a large breath in, hacking and coughing out. When I looked at the clock, I saw that all this had happened in twenty-four hours. I lost an entire day, but gained my faith. And seven years later I am not only still here, but, thriving.

diagnosis.severity_description: Very severe/near-terminal; given 1% chance of survival; extensive abdominal involvement (spleen, liver, intestines) with tumors; bowel obstruction from large tumor.
diagnosis.prognosis_given: One percent chance of survival; doctors told family to prepare for her 'arrangements' as they believed she would not survive.
diagnosis.quality_of_life_impact: Hospitalized; bowel obstruction with inability to pass stool and regurgitating food; required emergency surgery; extensive intestinal resection.
diagnosis.disease_duration_before_healing: Three months into being diagnosed (at time of surgical event).

treatment.treatments_raw: Emergency surgery for bowel obstruction; during surgery intestines were removed/handled and 2.5 feet of intestines were removed. She received one chemotherapy treatment (given against her will due to age).
treatment.surgery_type: Surgery for bowel obstruction; resection/removal of 2.5 feet of intestines.
treatment.surgery_outcome: Tumor was blocking bowels; 2.5 feet of intestines removed (extent of tumor removal not explicitly stated).
treatment.chemotherapy_response: After only one chemo treatment, doctors found the tumors were gone.

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: After only one chemo treatment the tumors were gone.
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Narrator reports doctors were 'awe struck' to find that after one chemotherapy treatment the tumors were gone; no imaging/lab modality specified.
remission_outcome.tumor_response: Tumors gone after one chemotherapy treatment.
remission_outcome.follow_up_duration_raw: Thirty-seven years later, I am still here.

turner_factors.agency_details: Narrator states chemotherapy was given against her will because she was too young for her protest to be heard.
intuition_examples: She reports knowing she was healed upon returning to her body after the NDE.
turner_factors.intuition_details: After returning from the NDE, she states she 'knew I was healed.'
turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Not explicitly prayer/meditation during the cancer episode; later she states the second experience led to 'gained my faith.'
purpose_sources: Sense of life purpose/mission ('you have much work left to do')
turner_factors.purpose_details: During the NDE a voice told her to go back because she had much work left to do.

existential_shift.identity_shift_description: During the NDE she reports being in an all-encompassing embrace of LOVE and experiencing expanded knowing/understanding.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: Reports profound love/peace and a directive to return because she had work to do; later (second experience) she reports gaining faith and thriving.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: NDE during surgery with message: 'My child, go back, for you have much work left to do!'
existential_shift.transformation_timing: NDE occurred during surgery; on returning she felt healed; later doctors found tumors gone after one chemotherapy treatment.

anomalous_experience.experience_description: During surgery she reports dying, observing the operating room from above (OBE features), entering a bright cloud-like realm with beings/angels, feeling overwhelming LOVE, and hearing a voice telling her to return because she had work to do.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: During emergency surgery for bowel obstruction caused by tumor, ~3 months after lymphoma diagnosis.
anomalous_experience.message_content: My child, go back, for you have much work left to do!

correspondential_markers.resolution_type: Transcendent experience characterized by overwhelming LOVE and a directive to return (purpose/mission).

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Burkitt's lymphoma described as extensive with 1% survival estimate; tumors reportedly gone after a single chemotherapy treatment.
validation.extraction_notes: Remission verification lacks specific imaging/lab modality and dates; chemo regimen unspecified. Narrative includes a second (non-cancer) overdose-related experience; cancer remission appears tied to NDE plus an unusually strong response to one chemo treatment.

analysis.case_summary: At age 13, the narrator was diagnosed with severe Burkitt's lymphoma with extensive abdominal tumors and a bowel obstruction requiring emergency surgery, during which she reports an NDE. She then received one chemotherapy treatment and reports doctors found the tumors were gone, with survival reported 37 years later.
key_healing_factors: Emergency surgery for bowel obstruction with intestinal resection
Single chemotherapy treatment followed by reported disappearance of tumors
Near-death experience with perceived message to return and sense of being healed
Spiritual strengthening/faith (explicitly stated later in life after a second overdose-related experience)
unique_features: NDE with veridical-appearing operating room observations (claimed accurate description of surgical actions)
Reported complete tumor disappearance after only one chemotherapy treatment despite 1% survival prognosis
Second separate overdose-related experience described as leading to renewed faith
analysis.analysis_notes: This is a human cancer case narrative with long-term survival. The remission is not 'pure spontaneous' because chemotherapy and surgery occurred; however, the response is described as unusually rapid. Medical verification is based on reported physician reaction without specified tests.
